maintenance_led.reason: Insurance brokerage earning commissions on policies and benefits placement; not repair, servicing or replacement of installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Commissions come from private businesses, families and individuals buying insurance, benefits and wealth services; Medicare sales are a minor part.

serial_acquirer.reason: Many offices are 'formerly' acquired agencies (BKS Partners, Guided Solutions, Founder Shield, Villages Insurance Partners), showing a roll-up growth history.

mission_critical.reason: Clients can move brokers fairly easily at renewal; insurance advisory, benefits and wealth services lack heavy switching costs.

notes: Serial acquirer judged from the many acquired-agency office names plus prior knowledge; the Baldwin Group has shifted toward organic growth recently.
